Coverage questions

Where does Service Robot Co. operate?
All 50 US states. We dispatch from the closest of 85+ metro hubs, so a robot reaches the job wherever it is. We are a service-area business — we come to you, so there is no storefront to visit.
Which cities can get same-day reach?
Major metros including New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas–Fort Worth, the Bay Area, Boston, Atlanta, Houston, and Phoenix. Elsewhere we offer 24-hour nationwide on-site dispatch and a 10-minute remote triage first response during business hours.
What if my city is not a major metro?
We still cover it. Coverage is nationwide across all 50 states, dispatched from the nearest hub. Tell us where the job is and we will confirm the timeline.
